name: JW Marriott Orlando Grande Lakes
insider_take: This Grande Lakes oasis feels more like a tropical resort than a typical Orlando hotel, with its stunning 500-acre natural preserve and championship golf right in your backyard.
whats_special: The JW Marriott Orlando Grande Lakes sits on a rare 500-acre ecological preserve featuring pristine wetlands and native Florida wildlife. It's home to the Greg Norman-designed Grande Lakes Golf Course and shares the property with The Ritz-Carlton, creating an upscale resort enclave just minutes from theme parks. The hotel's Primo restaurant showcases farm-to-table cuisine with ingredients grown on-site in their organic gardens.
pro_tip: Book a sunset kayak tour through the hotel's natural headwaters – it's one of the few remaining undeveloped waterways in Central Florida and offers incredible wildlife viewing opportunities.
dont_miss: The 40,000-square-foot spa featuring a rooftop relaxation pool, the evening firefly tours through the preserve (seasonal), and the signature lazy river that winds through lush landscaping. Golf enthusiasts should experience the 18th hole with its island green – a signature challenge designed by the Great White Shark himself.
pros: Luxury resort with championship golf course and full-service spa
Multiple dining options including award-winning restaurants
Convenient Orlando location with Disney World proximity
Extensive meeting and event facilities with professional services
cons: Large resort property may require walking distances between amenities
